scope.object: the C-covariant unfolding the six-move covariant unfolding (and its twelve-move version) on functions on the leaf, decomposed into omega's three charge sectors: dimensions, top moduli, slowest decays

claim_one_line: LISTENING 16, THE CHARGE SECTORS OF THE WHOLE ON THE LEAF (PROVED; data-free): the C-covariant unfolding commutes with omega's cyclic exchange on every leaf run; the neutral sector holds the constant and the slowest decay (0.88 to 0.99 per move) while the charged pair's strongest mode is 0.44 to 0.49, the two charged members identical; on the 3-tower both settle (0.986507 and 0.493254 at mod 81 and 243); post hoc, exactly: the six conjugated moves are closed under inversion (L^-1 = CRC^-1, R^-1 = C^2LC^-2, the third move CLC^-1 = (y, yz - x, z)), so the covariant whole is the symmetric walk on three move pairs, with no arrow of time; and on the 3-tower the charged spectrum is exactly half the neutral one below the top (ratio 2 to 12 digits; at primes 5 to 13 it is 1.89 to 2.09)
weave_or_thread: weave (every move acting together, nothing chosen)
